metadata.title: Retro Checkerboard Graphic with Glossy Script

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast black and white checkerboard background overlaid with a dynamic, glossy red script title featuring a sharp underline and secondary sans-serif block text.
excludeWhen: a minimalist or pastel color palette is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A rigid 8x8 black and white checkerboard grid serves as the foundation for a large, vibrant red script title that spans the upper third of the frame. The script is rendered with a 3D glossy effect, featuring white highlights and dark red shadows, and is underscored by a sharp, tapering horizontal bar. A secondary block of white sans-serif text is positioned within a single black square on the right side.
coreVisualRelationships: Rigid geometric grid vs. fluid organic script
High-contrast monochromatic background vs. saturated primary accent
coreInvariants: Perfectly square black and white checkerboard grid
Glossy red script with white specular highlights
Sharp, diagonal underline integrated into the script

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary script title is centered horizontally in the upper half, scaled to nearly the full width of the canvas.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large 'C' characters in the script act as the primary anchors, while the checkerboard grid provides a structural rhythm.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the upward diagonal slant of the script from left to right, then drops to the secondary text block on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The lower two-thirds of the checkerboard grid provide significant negative space, balancing the heavy typographic weight at the top.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between black and white; high saturation in the red script to create a focal point.

letterConstructionRules: Letters are connected with fluid strokes
Sharp, pointed terminals on the underline and descenders
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'C' features a large, sweeping top curve
The underline bar originates from the tail of the final letter and tapers to a point on the left
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-energy custom script paired with a neutral, functional sans-serif for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the base skeleton for the slanted, energetic script.
Matches the clean, uppercase secondary text block.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a flat, high-contrast black and white checkerboard pattern grid.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, glossy red 3D script title with white highlights and a sharp underline across the top, and a small block of white sans-serif text inside a black square on the right.

verificationChecks: Is the checkerboard grid perfectly aligned?
Does the red script have a visible 3D glossy effect?
Is the secondary text contained within a single grid square?
Is the red script slanted upwards?

postGenerationChecks: Verify specular highlights on the script
Ensure the red script is the dominant focal point
Confirm the secondary text is legible and centered in its square
recipe.reuseFormula: Checkerboard Grid + Glossy 3D Script + Sharp Underline + Condensed Sans-Serif Block
